Minol Acid and Chemicals P. Ltd. is a prominent industrial chemical manufacturing company based in the heart of Baroda, Gujarat, India—a region renowned for its robust chemical and petrochemical industries. Situated at 102 Sudhan Apartments, Opposite Tejas School, Race Course, Baroda-390007, the company has established itself as a reliable supplier of high-purity acids and specialty chemicals essential for a diverse range of industrial applications. Over the years, Minol Acid and Chemicals P. Ltd. has built a strong reputation for quality, consistency, and customer-centric service, catering to sectors such as pharmaceuticals, textiles, dyes and pigments, water treatment, metal processing, and agrochemicals.

The company specializes in the production and supply of inorganic acids, including hydrochloric acid (HCl), sulfuric acid (H₂SO₄), nitric acid (HNO₃), and other chemical reagents, all manufactured to meet stringent international quality standards. With a commitment to innovation, safety, and environmental responsibility, Minol adheres to rigorous quality control protocols and regulatory compliance norms. Its strategic location in Baroda—close to major industrial hubs, transportation networks, and the Vadodara railway junction—enables efficient distribution across Gujarat and beyond.

Minol Acid and Chemicals P. Ltd. prides itself on a skilled technical team, state-of-the-art infrastructure, and a deep understanding of chemical processes. The company continues to expand its product portfolio and client base through sustainable practices, technological upgrades, and a relentless focus on customer satisfaction, positioning itself as a trusted partner in India’s growing chemical industry.
